newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Possible management buyout fuels Seardel.
newsitem.headline: Possible management buyout fuels Seardel.

text.p: Industrial holding firm Seardel Investment Corp surged to a new year high on Thursday on news of a possible management buyout which could see the company delist, dealers said.

Seardel soared to 250 cents from its previous close of 144 cents in fairly active early trade -- a rise of over 73 percent. By 0826 GMT the share was 76 cents higher at 220 cents in a volume of 130,600 shares.
"It (the market) has reacted to the fact that they might delist and look at the net asset value of the company instead," one dealer said.
Seardel said earlier on Thursday that its chairman Aaron Searll and a consortium of senior management were considering plans to acquire all the investments owned by Seardel.
The move could result in Seardel becoming a cash shell company or being delisted.
